raw_comment:
I noticed that the middle of the country experiences more droughts than the coast’s.

I wonder why theres grey spots right next to exceptional droughts in West Virginia and North Dakota.

It relates to my community by impacting our environment and our living conditions. Droughts also negatively impacts food sources and farms which can damage the economy and our health.
